winefox.settings.page.title: WineFox Settings
winefox.settings.section.content.title: Content
winefox.settings.events.label: Enable WineFox events
winefox.settings.events.description: Allow WineFox-specific events to appear in future event rolls.
winefox.settings.potions.label: Enable WineFox potions
winefox.settings.potions.description: Allow WineFox normal potions to appear in future potion rolls.
winefox.settings.food.label: Enable WineFox food
winefox.settings.food.description: Allow WineFox food rewards and food-generating effects.
winefox.settings.publicRelics.label: Enable public WineFox relics
winefox.settings.publicRelics.descriptio: Allow selected WineFox relics to appear in shared relic rewards.
winefox.settings.restoreDefaults.label: Restore defaults
winefox.settings.restoreDefaults.descrip: Restore all WineFox content settings to their default enabled state.
winefox.cardArt.subpage.title: MagicWineFox Card Art
winefox.cardArt.subpage.description: Switch MagicWineFox card portraits between the full-art and the flat-color version.
winefox.cardArt.section.style.title: Overall style
winefox.cardArt.default.label: Use flat card art by default
winefox.cardArt.default.description: MagicWineFox cards use the flat portrait unless a per-card override below says otherwise.
winefox.cardArt.all.label: Switch every card to flat
winefox.cardArt.all.description: Clear per-card overrides and use the flat portrait for every MagicWineFox card.
winefox.cardArt.restore.label: Restore full art
winefox.cardArt.restore.description: Clear per-card overrides and return every MagicWineFox card to the full-art version.
winefox.cardArt.section.cards.title: Per-card override
winefox.cardArt.card.description: Use the flat portrait for this MagicWineFox card.
winefox.standee.subpage.title: WineFox Standee
winefox.standee.subpage.description: Tune part of the WineFox module settings.
winefox.standee.section.title: Battle standee
winefox.standee.variant.label: Standee
winefox.standee.variant.description: Takes effect from the next combat. The legacy standee has no low-health or death animation, so it keeps idling at low health and shows a falling pose on death.
winefox.standee.hud.section.title: Material display
winefox.standee.hud.offset_x.label: Horizontal offset
winefox.standee.hud.offset_x.description: Shifts your own material display horizontally on the battle screen. Only affects this client.
winefox.standee.hud.offset_y.label: Vertical offset
winefox.standee.hud.offset_y.description: Shifts your own material display vertically on the battle screen. Only affects this client.
winefox.standee.hud.reset.label: Reset material HUD offset
winefox.standee.hud.reset.description: Sets both offsets back to 0, restoring the default material HUD position.
winefox.magicWinefox.subpage.title: MagicWineFox Settings
winefox.magicWinefox.subpage.description: Tune part of the MagicWineFox module settings.
winefox.magicWinefox.section.links.title: More settings
winefox.magicWinefox.cardArt.subpage.des: Switch MagicWineFox card portraits between the full-art version and the flat-color version.
